source.name: ACEND Accredited Program Directory — Graduate Program in Nutrition and Dietetics (US)
source.notes: Retrieved from the ACEND directory application at acendportal.org (Directory.aspx, WebForms postbacks) filtered to country=United States and program type "Graduate Program in Nutrition and Dietetics". These are the entry-to-RDN pathway types (Graduate Programs under the Future Education Model, and Coordinated Programs combining didactic + supervised practice). Didactic-only (DPD), Dietetic Internships, Dietetic Technician, APD, and international programs excluded from this planner's scope.
